summary: KB Editor Redesign - All 13 features tested and verified. Sidebar shows Navigation header with '+' button, no file icons or metrics. Hover on articles shows settings gear icon. PageSettingsSlider contains all required fields (title, slug, description, sidebar title, keywords, tags, publishing toggle, delete button). Delete confirmation overlay works. Draft tag visible in navbar for unpublished pages. Category/section hover shows '+' icons. Chevron toggles expand/collapse. Docs page unchanged. Backend APIs support new fields (sidebar_title, keywords, tags).

issues: Console warning: 'flushSync was called from inside a lifecycle method' - React warning, not blocking functionality

critical_code_review_comments: ArticleSidebar.jsx uses CSS group-hover with named groups (group/art, group/sec, group/grp) correctly for hover effects
PageSettingsSlider.jsx has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Backend ArticleCreate and ArticleUpdate Pydantic models correctly include sidebar_title, keywords, tags fields
KBEditor.jsx properly shows Draft tag in navbar when form.published is false
seed_data_creation: None required - used existing KB articles
